meta.title: PCB Auto
meta.description: Compile a Chinese natural-language board idea into an orderable PCB: schematic, layout, routing, DRC and Gerber/BOM/PnP export, unattended. Ships four independent acceptance layers and a recomputable failure rate — so the answer is a measurement, not a demo.

tools.pcb_idea_to_design: Compile a Chinese board idea into a design JSON
tools.pcb_build: Run the full pipeline from a design JSON to fabrication artifacts
tools.pcb_fabcheck: Decide whether a product directory can be ordered as-is
tools.pcb_census: Run the DFM gate over every settled product directory
